feature.label: PLS-SEM Sample Size and Power Analysis

claim.supported_scope: Prospective Monte Carlo power and conservative grid selection for exactly two ordinary reflective constructs joined by one predictor-to-outcome path, with 3-10 declared loadings per block, standard-Gaussian data generation, standardized path-weighted PLS-PM, no missingness, and an indexed null-centered two-sided case-bootstrap plus-one path test.
claim.estimand: The probability that the frozen v2 PLS and null-centered case-bootstrap procedure rejects the target-path null under the declared effect, sample size, measurement design, and Gaussian data-generating assumptions.
assumptions: The one-path model, population coefficient, ordered loading vectors, standard-Gaussian distributions, no-missingness policy, alpha, and exact v2 test are declared before execution.
At least 90 percent of the requested inner case-bootstrap fits must be usable for an outer replicate to contribute an exact p value.
Power and the conservative decision apply only to the displayed design and evaluated sample-size grid.
exclusions: Retrospective observed power, heuristic sample-size rules, smoothing, interpolation, and extrapolation are excluded.

Formative, higher-order, interaction, multigroup, nonlinear, mixture, endogeneity, weighted, clustered, ordinal, matrix-only, multi-path, control-variable, alternate-distribution, and missing-data designs are excluded.
The result is not a guarantee of convergence, measurement validity, external validity, data quality, or adequacy for an unplanned analysis.
warnings: Power is conditional on the declared generator, estimator, inferential test, alpha, and target path.
Failed outer replicates remain in the planned power denominator and failed inner fits remain in typed accounting.
Archive validation recomputes the stored arithmetic and identities but does not regenerate every dataset or cryptographically authenticate a coordinated archive rewrite.

Method-level offline qualification requires zero external QuickPLS application/page requests; sampled Microsoft-managed WebView2 background egress is recorded separately and does not satisfy the pending commercial zero-process-egress gate.

equations.expression: p_r = (1 + sum_b I(abs(beta_star_rb - beta_hat_r) >= abs(beta_hat_r))) / (1 + U_r)
n_min = min{n in N_grid : Wilson_lower(power_hat(n), R) >= target_power}

references.citation: Muthen and Muthen (2002), How to Use a Monte Carlo Study to Decide on Sample Size and Determine Power
Independent NumPy bounded generator, Mode-A PLS estimator, indexed case bootstrap, null-centered tail count, plus-one probability, Wilson interval, and frozen calibration profile

simulations.design: Frozen independent NumPy null profiles at n=160 and n=320, 300 outer runs per point, 99 indexed case-bootstrap fits per run, reflective loadings 0.80, and population path zero.
simulations.seed_policy: A frozen validation-only domain separates effect, sample size, outer index, generated data, and bootstrap inference; it consumes no QuickPLS result.
simulations.acceptance_rule: The pooled 95 percent Wilson interval contains 0.05, pooled rejection is at most 0.065, each point is at most 0.08, every outer run completes, and the inner fit-failure rate is at most 0.001 with failures retained.

simulations.design: Frozen independent NumPy profile with population path 0.45, n=60, 100 outer runs, 99 indexed case-bootstrap fits per run, and reflective loadings 0.80.
simulations.seed_policy: The same frozen validation-only indexed-domain policy as the null profile.
simulations.acceptance_rule: At least 0.60 of successful outer runs reject, every outer run completes, and the retained inner fit-failure rate remains within the same 0.001 bound.

boundaries.case: A v1 recipe/result is submitted for new execution or relabeled with the v2 method, schema, stream, or inference identity.
boundaries.expected_behavior: Historical v1 remains readable under v1 while execution and append validation reject every mixed or relabeled identity.

boundaries.case: Requested, usable, failed, exceedance, p-value, rejection, row, digest, or grid-decision evidence is altered.
boundaries.expected_behavior: Strict validation recomputes the plus-one probability and all deterministic summaries and rejects the payload atomically.

boundaries.case: The same v2 scientific recipe and seed run under different supported worker counts.
boundaries.expected_behavior: The indexed outcome ledger and analytical payload are exactly equal apart from operational provenance.

boundaries.case: One or more indexed inner case-bootstrap fits fail while at least 90 percent remain usable.
boundaries.expected_behavior: No retry or replacement occurs; exact requested, usable, failed, and exceedance counts determine the plus-one probability.

boundaries.case: Execution is cancelled and the same immutable v2 recipe is retried.
boundaries.expected_behavior: Cancellation appends no result and retry reproduces the uninterrupted analytical payload.

tamper_tests.expected_behavior: Reject a capability, method, inference, stream, or schema identity mismatch.
Reject a result whose immutable design, counts, seed, settings, recipe digest, or v2 method identity differs from its recipe.

Reject changed requested, usable, failed, exceedance, probability, or rejection evidence, plus duplicate keys, unknown fields, non-finite values, partial ledgers, invalid grids, or inconsistent denominators.
Reject a changed project dataset fingerprint even though observed rows are not simulated.
Reject any modified archive member whose checksum differs.
Never reinterpret the failed-calibration v1 result as v2 evidence.

persistence.legacy_policy: pls_sample_size_power_v1 remains readable under its historical identity and is non-executable; only exact v2 recipes may create new results.

setup_controls: Ordered loading vectors and population path
Sample-size grid, alpha, target power, and Wilson confidence
Monte Carlo and case-bootstrap replicate counts
Seed, workers, tolerance, and maximum iterations
Fixed standard-Gaussian and no-missing design disclosures
applicability_blockers: Unsupported model shape or measurement block
Invalid grid, probability, inference, replicate count, or workload
Historical v1 inference selected for new execution
result_surfaces: Power and Wilson interval by sample size
Outer simulation and inner bootstrap tail accounting
Named failures, assumptions, exclusions, and run provenance
native.gui_cli_parity_rule: For the same exact v2 recipe and seed, GUI and CLI ordered analytical payloads are equal apart from operational timestamps.
accessibility_rules: Every curve value has an equivalent accessible table row.
The decision, accounting, assumptions, exclusions, and failures require neither color nor pointer interaction.
